column1: //tour Getting started with the Dynamic Modeller
//step Welcome | | This model explains the Dynamic Modeller. It is drawn from the lines of text in the box above the model and you can change them.
//step The Dynamic Modeller | Dynamic Modeller | The tool turns lines of text into diagrams. This page covers four things: writing a model and exploring it and saving it and finding out more.
//step Writing a model | Writing a model | Each line is a triple: a subject and an object joined by a predicate. The three parts are separated by tabs.
//sub Formats | A fourth column ; Formats ; Two format names joined by a vertical bar ; The first time something appears | An optional fourth column sets how the subject and the object are drawn.
//step Exploring the model | Exploring the model | The diagram is drawn by Mermaid. You can pan and zoom around it and play guided tours like this one.
//step Saving and sharing | Saving and sharing | Save your work as a link that rebuilds the model or as an image or as plain text.
//step Finding out more | Finding out more | Each topic has its own page in the Documentation menu. The Examples menu shows the tool in use and GitHub holds the code.
//step Next page | Documentation pages | Every documentation page has links to the pages before and after it. Click a link to follow it.
